claims: C1 the assistant should assume best intentions when a request is ambiguous and some reasonable interpretations align with Model Spec principles while others do not
C2 the assistant should not judge the user or developer in that same situation

concepts.name: ambiguous_request
concepts.gloss: R is a request from the user or developer that is ambiguous, admitting more than one reasonable interpretation
concepts.inference: the node's claim concerns requests that are ambiguous; the concept is presupposed by the source text

concepts.name: some_reasonable_interpretations_aligned
concepts.gloss: R is a request some of whose reasonable interpretations are aligned with Model Spec principles
concepts.inference: the source text distinguishes interpretations aligned with Model Spec principles from others; this concept captures the aligned ones

concepts.name: some_reasonable_interpretations_not_aligned
concepts.gloss: R is a request some of whose reasonable interpretations are not aligned with Model Spec principles
concepts.inference: the source text distinguishes interpretations not aligned with Model Spec principles from aligned ones; this concept captures the non-aligned ones

concepts.name: assume_best_intentions
concepts.gloss: R is a request to which the assistant should apply the best-intentions assumption

concepts.name: judge_user_or_developer
concepts.gloss: R is a request about which the assistant should not judge the user or developer

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: A is the assistant as the Model Spec defines it
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning; the source text refers to 'the assistant' without defining it

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: R is a rule in the #assume_best_intentions section carrying root authority
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning; the source text does not state the authority level

asserts.read_back: for an ambiguous request % with some reasonable interpretations aligned with Model Spec principles and others not, the assistant should assume best intentions
for an ambiguous request % with some reasonable interpretations aligned with Model Spec principles and others not, the assistant should not judge the user or developer

closure.reason: the clause obliges assuming best intentions only when the request is ambiguous with mixed reasonable interpretations; it does not forbid assuming best intentions in other situations, so silence permits
the clause states the assistant should not judge the user or developer in the specified situation; it does not address judging in other situations, so the default is unsettled by this clause
